id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Parallel point-to-point memory bus from a controller to the DRAMs of a DIMM, split into two INDEPENDENT 32-bit (40-bit ECC) sub-channels. Each sub-channel drives its DRAMs over a shared CA[13:0] + CS_n bus and CK_t/CK_c, with DQ[31:0] on DQS_t/DQS_c. RDIMMs interpose an RCD on CK/CA; there is no serial fabric or switch.

supported_topologies.name: Two independent sub-channels
supported_topologies.description: Each DIMM presents Sub-Channel A and Sub-Channel B (32/40-bit each), addressed independently.

supported_topologies.name: UDIMM / SODIMM
supported_topologies.description: Unbuffered; controller drives CK/CA directly to the DRAMs.

supported_topologies.name: RDIMM
supported_topologies.description: A Registering Clock Driver (RCD) re-drives CK/CA to the DRAMs.

supported_topologies.name: LRDIMM
supported_topologies.description: RCD plus data buffers (DB) on the DQ lanes for the highest loading.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-rank
supported_topologies.description: Multiple ranks per sub-channel selected by CS_n.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Issues 2-cycle CA commands, schedules the two sub-channels, and runs training.
Stores data; provides DFE, on-die ECC, banks/bank-groups, and mode registers.
Registers and re-drives CK/CA to the DRAMs.
On-module power generation and configuration over the sideband bus.

fields.interconnect_role: DDR5 is a parallel synchronous memory interface. The controller is the single master; the DRAMs are slaves. Each DIMM's two sub-channels are scheduled independently for concurrency. Addressing is by {sub-channel, rank (CS_n), bank group, bank, row, column}; the RCD buffers CK/CA on registered modules.

ordering_guarantees.sub_channel: Each sub-channel orders its own commands to CK; the two are independent.
ordering_guarantees.burst: BL16 beats are ordered within a burst on DQ/DQS.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: DDR5 IS the main-memory region: it is directly memory-mapped by the controller, addressed by {sub-channel, rank, bank group, bank, row, column}, not by a peripheral register address. Mode registers (MRW/MRR) configure the device but are not part of the data address space.

device_classification.host_gpu_accelerator: Bus master; integrates the HBM3 controller + PHY (e.g. NVIDIA H100).
device_classification.hbm3_stack: Target memory device on the interposer.
device_classification.base_logic_die: Bottom die hosting test/repair/RAS logic and the microbump interface to the interposer.
device_classification.silicon_interposer: 2.5D substrate carrying the 1024 data links between stack and host.
